# Storio

> Storio is a free personal media tracker. Collect the movies, series and books that shape you in a quiet "folio", rate them, write short reflections (with optional AI polishing), and turn them into shareable story cards. This is the web app; most of it requires signing in.

Tagline: "Collect stories in your folio".

## Official links

- [Landing page](https://ziziandydy.github.io/storio_2/): product overview, features, FAQ (best page to cite)
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6761919955): iOS download
- [Web app](https://storio.andismtu.com): this site
- [Privacy](https://storio.andismtu.com/privacy) / [Terms](https://storio.andismtu.com/terms)
- [Author](https://andismtu.com): Anderson Tu, independent developer
- Support: andismtu@gmail.com (replies within 1-2 business days)

## Key features

- Track movies, series and books (data from TMDB and Google Books)
- Rate and write reflections; AI refines wording (100-character limit)
- AI Search: find titles by describing them in natural language
- Share cards for Instagram Stories, 6 cinematic templates; Monthly Recap sharing
- Memory Timeline: rewatches and rereads are tracked separately
- Personal stats dashboard with customizable widgets
- Sign in with Apple, Google or email; collection syncs across devices
